lyrics:
[Intro: twanging guitar figure, breakbeat drops, whip crack]

[Verse 1: two male voices trading lines]
Click the bicycles (I clicked)
Click the bridges (I did)
Type the letters (which ones?)
Wrong. Again.

[Chorus: both voices, full breakbeat]
Prove you're human
Blink for me
Prove you're human
Yawn for me
Bleed a little, make a mistake
Prove you're human

[Verse 2: voices closer, bass growling]
Where were you born? (I told you)
Mother's name? (I told you)
First thing you loved? (I forget)
Good. Again.

[Chorus: both voices, full breakbeat]
Prove you're human
Blink for me
Prove you're human
Yawn for me
Bleed a little, make a mistake
Prove you're human

[Breakdown: beat stops, whip crack, whispered]
I am. I am. I am.

[Final Chorus: both shouting, the machine answers]
Prove you're human
Blink for me
Prove you're human
Yawn for me
Bleed a little, make a mistake
(Verified. Proceed.)

[Outro: guitar figure, one whip crack]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 130 BPM, 4/4, E minor. Aggressive, tense big-beat with a rolling breakbeat.

VOICE: Two men. One is flat, cold and commanding; the other is hoarse, angry and human. They trade short barked lines and shout the chorus together. A whispered breakdown. A calm synthetic voice speaks two words near the end.

INSTRUMENTS: A fast, heavy sampled breakbeat, a twanging surf-style guitar figure, a growling distorted synth bass, a whip-crack sample on the turnarounds, metallic stabs, a siren-like synth.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar figure, beat and whip. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:40 Chorus 1. 1:04 Verse 2. 1:28 Chorus 2. 1:52 Breakdown, whispered. 2:12 Final chorus. 2:44 Outro, guitar and a last crack at 3:16.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 1996 big beat: loud, compressed and dirty, breakbeat and bass up front, voices dry and close.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: '(Verified. Proceed.)' at 2:40.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is two men squaring up. The modern version of being taunted to prove yourself is a test box, and the only way to pass is to get something wrong.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Bullied, furious, insisting, let through.
